**Observation Log:**

[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/28 (Sun) 05:59  
[EVENT] User is planning to cook chicken stir-fry for dinner tonight.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants tips on how to make the chicken stir-fry taste more authentic, like the Chinese food they ordered as takeout in the past month.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips for making chicken stir-fry taste more authentic, including using a wok or large skillet, choosing the right oil, selecting the right type of chicken, marinating the chicken, using aromatics, adding a variety of vegetables, stir-frying quickly, using the right sauces, not overcooking, adding scallions and sesame oil at the end, and tasting and adjusting.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Assistant provided an authentic chicken stir-fry recipe with the following ingredients: 1 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast or thighs, 2 tablespoons vegetable oil, 2 cloves garlic (minced), 1-inch piece of ginger (minced), 1 small onion (sliced), 2 cups mixed vegetables (bell peppers, carrots, broccoli, snap peas), 2 tablespoons soy sauce, 1 tablespoon oyster sauce (optional), 1 tablespoon cornstarch, salt and pepper to taste, scallions and sesame oil for garnish.  
[PREFERENCE] User is unsure about using oyster sauce in the recipe and wants to know more about it.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant explained that oyster sauce is a savory condiment made from oyster extract, sugar, water, and sometimes cornstarch, adding depth and umami flavor to dishes.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant stated that oyster sauce is not necessary for the recipe and provided alternatives: soy sauce, hoisin sauce, teriyaki sauce, mushroom-based sauces, or omitting it altogether.  
[PREFERENCE] User decided to omit the oyster sauce this time and see how the dish turns out.  
[EVENT] User has been experimenting with new cooking techniques and tools, including an Instant Pot and spiralizer.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant encouraged user to use the Instant Pot for cooking chicken and vegetables before stir-frying and suggested using the spiralizer for making zucchini or sweet potato noodles.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant reminded user that the key to a great stir-fry is to have all ingredients prepped and ready to go before cooking.  
[PREFERENCE] User wants to know about other vegetables that pair well with chicken in a stir-fry.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a list of vegetables that pair well with chicken in a stir-fry, including bok choy, mushrooms, snow peas, baby corn, zucchini, yellow squash, eggplant, green beans, water chestnuts, kale, red bell pepper, pineapple, celery, and carrots.
